Vendored files for the offline arcade.

PressStart2P-Regular.woff2   (NOT included yet, add it here)
  Press Start 2P by CodeMan38, SIL Open Font License 1.1.
  Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/pressstart2p
  That folder has PressStart2P-Regular.ttf and OFL.txt. Convert the .ttf to .woff2 (for example with
  https://github.com/google/woff2 or any online ttf-to-woff2 converter), save it as
  PressStart2P-Regular.woff2 next to this file, and copy OFL.txt here too (the licence requires it).
  Until the file is added the arcade falls back to a system monospace font and the browser logs one 404 for it.

planck.js   (for the pool game, add under /shared/vendor/planck/ with its MIT LICENSE file)
